reigns.note: King of Sparta under whom the Lacedaemonians sent colonies to Croton in Italy and to the Locri by the Western headland — colonial-era marker only, not a Locrian king. Not the Theban Polydorus son of Cadmus (`polydorus`). No named founder of Epizephyrian Locri is attested in the seven lenses.

When war arose between Croton and the Locri in Italy, the Locri called upon Ajax son of Oileus for help, citing kinship with the Opuntians — ancestral hero-cult aid in battle, not civic residence at Epizephyrian Locri (his homes remain Opus and the Trojan cycle).

Boxer of the Italian Locrians who dwell near the West Point headland, called son of Astycles or of the river Caecinus that divides Locrian land from Rhegium — the only named Locrian-born figure in the seven lenses. Not promoted as a character node; city sky stays empty of residences.
